specs.Multiple Voice Assistants: Control your TV with your voice using the assistant you prefer—be it Bixby or Amazon Alexa—for a hands-free, simple interaction
specs.Free Access to Over 100+ Channels: From movies and sports to kids' shows and news, enjoy a wide range of free channels, including premium ones, with fresh content added regularly
specs.OTS Lite: Object Tracking Sound Lite delivers 3D surround sound that moves with the visuals, pulling you deeper into the action with every scene
specs.HDR: High Dynamic Range increases contrast between white and black, producing rich colors and bold details, even in the most extreme light or dark scenes
specs.Images Come to Life With Depth: Flat visuals become more layered with Contrast Enhancer, which automatically adjusts contrast levels to add depth and dimension to every frame
specs.Adaptive Sound: Whether it's a whisper or an explosion, Adaptive Sound uses real-time intelligence to fine-tune audio based on what you’re watching
specs.Q-Symphony: Let your TV and soundbar work together. Q-Symphony syncs them without muting the TV speakers, creating a layered soundscape that feels fuller and richer
specs.Samsung Tizen OS: Samsung’s Tizen OS transforms your TV into an all-in-one hub for streaming, apps, and smart features. Explore thousands of movies and shows effortlessly
